Restore the upstream `app_server_adapter.rs` header, helper code, and
test scaffolding that were accidentally dropped during the rebase
conflict resolution.

Keep only the intended legacy approval bridge behavior on top so the
PR diff stays focused on approval compatibility instead of unrelated
adapter churn.
